cl.x: Provide SikaRoof® VersiJack® Concealed Paver Retainer where documented, installed or applied in accordance with this clause and the manufacturer's Product Data Sheet (August 2026, Version 01.01).

s: SikaRoof® VersiJack® Concealed Paver Retainer is a hidden accessory to increase the wind uplift resistance of pavers in raised flooring applications. Concealed paver retainers are manufactured from recycled polypropylene (PP) and acrylonitrile butadiene styrene (ABS), and it uses plates adhered to the base of the paver before locking them into the system to achieve wind uplift resistance.

SikaRoof® VersiJack® Concealed Paver Retainer is used in conjunction with SikaRoof® VersiJack® and may be locked and unlocked to release the plates allowing pavers to be removed and reinstalled after completion.

cl.t: Intended uses stated by the manufacturer
cl.x: Concealed paver retainer system for raised paving installations on podiums, balconies, roof terraces and areas with hardscape finishes.
Observe the manufacturer's limitations stated in clause 4.3.

cl.c: Data sheet page 2: Application Instructions > Substrate Preparation
cl.x: Clean and sound surface shall have at least a wood float finish. All holes, joints, and cracks and honeycombs in concrete or masonry surfaces shall be filled with an approved grout and allowed to cure. High spots in concrete or masonry surfaces shall be cut off or ground down to prevent damage/puncture to the pedestal base.
Apply in accordance with the manufacturer's Product Data Sheet (August 2026, Version 01.01) and the requirements below.

cl.c: Data sheet page 2: Application Instructions > Application
cl.x: SikaRoof® VersiJack® Concealed Paver Retainer shall be installed onto SikaRoof® VersiJack®. Paver base would then be adhered onto the plates with an approved adhesive. The first paver shall be installed to the correct elevation before using a levelling device to serve as a reference. Subsequent pavers shall be installed and checked to ensure consistent and correct elevation, till a sturdy and rigid raised flooring is obtained, free of rattling, squeaking or other noises.

s: SikaRoof® VersiJack® Concealed Paver Retainer is not resistant to permanent weathering and UV exposure.
tr: For more information, please contact Sika Sales Personnel.
